subject: Chemistry
question: The correct order of acidic strength of the major products formed in the given reactions (A to D) is: (see diagram)
explanation: Explanation: Product [A] is benzoic acid (pKa ≈ 4.2), Product [B] is propanoic acid (pKa ≈ 4.8), Product [C] is formic acid (pKa ≈ 3.8), and Product [D] is phenylacetic acid (pKa ≈ 4.3). Acidic strength increases as pKa decreases. Thus, the order is C > A > D > B.
